What’s in the Early Access version?[/h2][list][*][p]Malakar Boss Fight Editions (Challenge Modifiers)[/p][/*][*][p]Endless Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Seeded Runs[/p][/*][*][p]New Achievements[/p][/*][*][p]2 New Books[/p][/*][*][p]New Trinkets[/p][/*][*][p]New Scrolls[/p][/*][*][p]New Amulets and Auras[/p][/*][*][p]New Bosses, Elites and Minions[/p][/*][*][p]Shop Updates[/p][/*][*][p]Visual and Sound Improvements[/p][/*][/list][p]We already have a clear vision of what’s in store throughout Early Access and will share a roadmap with you all on launch day — so keep an eye out for it![/p][p]We can’t wait for you to dive into this Early Access version, share your feedback here on Steam or on the game’s Discord server, and help us iterate as much as possible leading up to version 1.0 and beyond![/p][p][/p][h3]Wishlist now and get notified at launch![/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073990/Runeborn/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: July Recap – Parties, Playtesting, and Plenty of Progress!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey adventurers![/h1][p]July has been another incredible month for [i]Runeborn[/i]—full of events, testing, new features, and community conversations that are shaping the future of the game. Here’s a look at everything that’s been happening behind the scenes (and in person!).[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🎉 Our Pre-Launch Party Was a Blast![/b][/h3][p]We kicked off July with an [b]in-person pre-launch party[/b] at [url="https://www.windsoreats.com/"]WindsorEats[/url], hosted by our friends at [url="https://www.wetech-alliance.com/"]WeTech Alliance[/url], and it was a smashing success!  It was amazing to meet some of you face-to-face, share early builds, and celebrate how far we’ve come. The energy in the room was incredible—thank you to everyone who came out![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/a630f3c42237dc4efc52bea2c2929c2fbeaf9b3f.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]⚔️ Testing, Balancing & Building[/b][/h3][p]We’ve been testing [b]new runebooks[/b], tweaking their balance, and seeing how they shake up runs. We’re also developing [b]new amulets and auras[/b] to add even more depth and variety.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/f97d6383d3accf79bbf27bcacbb291bd466db24f.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🛠️ System Overhauls & Quality of Life[/b][/h3][p]We’re rewriting our [b]save/load system[/b] from the ground up to ensure a smoother and more consistent experience.  We’ve also made tons of [b]quality-of-life updates[/b], like adding titles and descriptions to empty trinket and scroll slots, plus exploring [b]new ways to speed up gameplay[/b] for those who like to go fast.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🎨 Visual & Audio Improvements[/b][/h3][p]We’re continuing to polish the game’s look and feel:[/p][list][*][p][b]Updating scroll and trinket artwork[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Reworking UI elements[/b] (shop designs, new run screens, and maybe even the rune inventory!)[/p][/*][*][p]Adding [b]more sound effects and music for bosses[/b] to make battles even more epic[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/31af753f3930f142a5c9cb52b84993987bccc8bd.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🌍 Better Localization Tools[/b][/h3][p]We’ve updated our [b]localization tooling[/b] so we can easily improve translations and keep them up-to-date as new features roll out. This should help us deliver more accurate language support moving forward.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🤝 Partnering with Influencers[/b][/h3][p]We’ve teamed up with [url="https://www.linkedin.com/company/oncade/"]Oncade[/url], a platform that allows influencers to earn commissions for promoting [i]Runeborn[/i]. This means more content creators will share their runs and show off creative builds—perfect for spreading the word![/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🐞 Bug Fixes & Prototypes[/b][/h3][p]We’ve fixed [b]dozens of bugs[/b], improved stability, and even started [b]prototyping new ideas and concepts[/b] that we’re still testing internally. No spoilers yet, but we’re excited about what’s cooking![/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]💬 Thank You, Community![/b][/h3][p]As always, we want to thank you for your amazing support and the lively conversations on [b]Discord[/b]. Your feedback, bug reports, and screenshots keep us motivated every day. If you haven’t joined yet, [b]come say hello and share a screenshot of your best run![/b][/p][p]We know many of you are asking about a [b]release date[/b]. We’re not quite ready to lock one in yet—but we promise we’ll keep you posted. Thank you for being patient as we continue polishing the game. We want to launch with our best foot forward, and your support helps us get there.[/p][p]Stay sharp—and stay Runeborn.[/p][p]– The Runeborn Team[/p]

notes.title: June Recap – What We Learned & What’s Next
notes.content:
[h1]Hey adventurers![/h1][p]June was a massive month for [i]Runeborn[/i], and we couldn’t be more grateful for the amazing support we’ve received. From Steam Next Fest to your bug reports and feedback, the community has truly shown up. Let’s take a look at what happened—and what’s coming next.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎉 Steam Next Fest Was a Huge Success[/h3][p]First off, [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who played the demo, streamed it, and shared your feedback during Steam Next Fest. We saw an incredible surge of interest, and your support means the world to our small team.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/8122fab0c7f8f15ecad50e252eeb410922d59510.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔍 What We Learned[/h3][p]With thousands of new players jumping into the demo, we’ve had the chance to learn a lot:[/p][list][*][p][b]Machine-translated languages need love.[/b] Many of you pointed out inconsistencies and errors in our AI-assisted translations. Thanks for your patience—we’re working on improving them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Too much RNG?[/b] A lot of players mentioned that the randomness can sometimes get in the way of planning. We hear you.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More music & sound effects.[/b]  We need to add more BGM variety and improved SFX.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Punchier animations.[/b]  It is recommended that we add more punch to our animations, especially when getting a 4 or 5 match.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Speed controls.[/b]  You want more granular controls for animation/retriggering speeds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Replayability is strong.[/b] Despite that, the demo's variety and depth are keeping players coming back for more.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Art & polish are hitting home.[/b] We've received tons of praise for the look and feel of the game—thank you![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ What We’re Working On[/h3][p]Our focus is now fully on building out the [b]Early Access version[/b] of [i]Runeborn[/i]. Here’s what’s in progress:[/p][list][*][p][b]Town Between Chapters:[/b] We’re adding a new [i]town area[/i] between chapters where you’ll have access to all shop types. This should ease some of the RNG frustrations and give you more control over your builds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Runebooks:[/b]  We're testing 3-5 new Runebooks for our Early Access build.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes & Balance Updates:[/b] We’re digging into all the issues you reported and continuing to tune the game for a smoother experience.[/p][/*][/list][p]Special shoutout to everyone who used the [b]F2 bug reporting tool[/b]—those reports have been incredibly helpful.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]💬 Community Shoutouts[/h3][list][*][p]Our [b]Discord[/b] has been buzzing with awesome suggestions, especially around [b]new trinket ideas[/b] and gameplay tweaks. Keep them coming—we’re listening![/p][/*][*][p]Huge thanks to [b]Olexa[/b] for featuring [i]Runeborn[/i] again on YouTube. That video has over [b]48,000 views[/b], and we’ve welcomed many new faces since then. If you're one of them, [b]welcome to the community![/b] 👋[/p][/*][/list][previewyoutube="W5-JChQZxFc;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][p]That’s it for now. We’ve got some exciting stuff in the works, and we’ll be sharing more sneak peeks as we get closer to Early Access.[/p][p]Thanks again for playing, for testing, for sharing your ideas, and for being part of the journey.
Stay sharp—and stay Runeborn.[/p][p]– The Runeborn Team[/p]

notes.title: June Update – Global Localization, Steam Deck Support & Balance Changes
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings adventurers![/h2][p]We’re back with another big update for the Runeborn demo (0.5)—and this one’s all about opening the gates to more players, improving the experience, and making each run feel better paced and more rewarding. Let’s dive in!

[/p][h3]🌍 Now Localized in 10 Languages![/h3][p]Runeborn is now playable in nine additional languages:
Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, and Spanish.
[/p][list][*][p] We worked with professional translators for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese to ensure high-quality localization.
[/p][/*][*][p] The remaining languages were translated using machine translation and AI assistance. While we’ve done our best to polish them, they might not be perfect—please let us know if you spot anything off!
[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re also officially launching in Asian markets on [b]June 5th, 2025[/b]. Welcome to all our new players—we’re thrilled to have you on this journey!

[/p][h3]🎮 Partial Steam Deck & Controller Support[/h3][list][*][p] You asked, we listened. Runeborn now has partial controller support for Xbox, PlayStation, and other modern gamepads. [/p][/*][*][p] It also runs great on Steam Deck so you can take your roguelike deckbuilding on the go.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎥 Updated Launch Trailer[/h3][p]To celebrate all the improvements and our global rollout, we’ve released a brand-new launch trailer!  It features updated gameplay and new trinket art—perfect for sharing with a friend who’s curious about the game.

[/p][previewyoutube="K2Gfc3kjURQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Let us know what you think—we’re proud of how far Runeborn has come!

[/p][h3]📅 Coming to Steam Next Fest – June 9th[/h3][list][*][p] We’re excited to announce that Runeborn will be part of Steam Next Fest, starting June 9th!
[/p][/*][*][p] This is your chance to jump into the updated demo, experience all the latest changes, and share your feedback with us.
[/p][/*][*][p] We’ll be hanging out during the event, streaming gameplay, answering questions, and talking with the community. Be sure to stop by our store page and join the fun!
[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧭 Better Game Flow & Run Length[/h3][p]With the addition of Chapter 3 in Early Access, we noticed that complete runs were starting to feel like a slog, especially once Chapter 4 entered the mix. To keep runs engaging and rewarding:
[/p][list][*][p] Chapters have been shortened from 9 levels to 7.
[/p][/*][*][p] This change keeps the pacing tight and lets players reach elite and boss rewards more frequently.
[/p][/*][*][p] To compensate, we’ve increased the difficulty of the first three levels, so your journey still starts with a challenge.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎨 Visual Improvements[/h3][list][*][p] Over 100 trinkets have received updated artwork to better match their theme and rarity.

[img src="https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45193475/fca6a762ef874f4a068d5d825b56b4370a0cfd18.png"][/img]
[/p][/*][*][p] Tooltips got a visual facelift, making it easier to quickly parse important info mid-run.

[img src="https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45193475/7ff08e78b80b9d98a8ded16dbfed0b329178cf30.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p] And to spice up boss encounters, we’ve added a new effect for each boss—see if you can spot them!
[/p][/*][*][p] What we're dubbing "Hot Trinkets" - a new visual way to see how much a Trinket is contributing towards your Cast

[img src="https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45193475/12f12451e573a5665d14d4896991f120e8cba96a.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes & Patch Notes[/h3][list][*][p] We’ve squashed dozens of bugs and made various under-the-hood improvements.
[/p][/*][*][p] Full patch notes are below.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Patch Notes[/h3][p][b]Summary[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] 100+ NEW Trinket Art
[/p][/*][*][p] Added Localization: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, and Spanish
[/p][/*][*][p] Added Basic Controller Support (Virtual Cursor)
[/p][/*][*][p] NEW Tooltip Art to improve readability
[/p][/*][*][p] Bosses now have additional abilities
[/p][/*][*][p] Removed most error popups and implemented error sounds and animations in their place
[/p][/*][*][p] Added Trinket Slot Reward animation feedback
[/p][/*][*][p] Vypras Forced Hold visuals updated
[/p][/*][*][p] Added click to skip cutscenes (Comic, Elite & Boss Intros)
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance Changes[/h3][list][*][p] Chapters now have 7 levels
[/p][/*][*][p] HP Curve updated to account for new Chapter length
[/p][/*][*][p] Removed Ghorlock boss from Demo
[/p][/*][*][p] Curse of Replication will now target non-Unique trinkets if possible
[/p][/*][*][p] Enemy abilities no longer trigger after they die
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Trinket Updates[/h3][list][*][p] [b]Jade Bell:[/b] Double your Coins gained from Interest [i](Previously: +1 Coin for every 5 Coins owned when an enemy is defeated (Maximum +10 Coins))[/i]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Gift Box:[/b] +2 Coins per Common Trinket you own at the start of a fight [i](Previously: Conjure 2 Common Trinkets at the start of a fight)[/i]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Nugget of Wisdom:[/b] +2 Coins when you deal greater than or equal to 50% of the Enemy's total HP in a single Cast [i](Previously: +4 Coins when an enemy is defeated)[/i]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Faberge Egg:[/b] After 3 more Enemies are defeated, Evolves to make a copy of a random Trinket, including its Gem [i](Previously: After 3 more Enemies are defeated, sell this to make a copy of a random Trinket, including its Gem)[/i]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Flickering Flame:[/b] +50% to all listed Amulet values [i](Previously: Retrigger all Runes for the next 5 Casts)[/i]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Peg Leg:[/b] Degrade value changed from [b]3 [/b]-> [b]1[/b]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Axe Akimbo:[/b] Damage changed from [b]300 [/b]-> [b]400[/b]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Jeweler's Loupe:[/b] xMulti changed from [b]0.5x[/b] -> [b]0.4x[/b]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Wild Card:[/b] Moved from [b]Rare[/b] to [b]Legendary[/b]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Ocarina:[/b] Now works with [b]Elite[/b] and [b]Boss Chests[/b] as well
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Frostbite:[/b]  Now only activates on [b]Meditate[/b] and [b]Cast[/b]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Sigil of Speed:[/b] Now starts tracking when you get the trinket rather than from the start of the level [i](If obtained mid way through a level, you can now still earn the highest rarity trinket)[/i]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Sprinting Shoes:[/b] Removed
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Nullification:[/b] Removed
[/p][/*][*][p] Added a new [b]Duplicate[/b] keyword on Trinkets that have been duplicated by [b]Curse of Replication, Faberge Egg[/b]
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p] Fixed an issue where changing resolutions in-game caused an error
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where the end of run jingle was being played as a sound effect, using the incorrect volume slider setting
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where destroying a trinket slot that was being copied by Chameleon Tail would cause an error
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where match previews did not work with Double Trouble
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where Black Ice Amulet did not work with Daoist Bracers
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where Helping Hand and Avia would cause Wild Runes to morph into their final rune prematurely
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where Dark Magic would not connect to Wilds
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where hovering trinkets during a cast would display incorrect values for Grow trinkets
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where Mobius Scroll Case would work with Forbidden Scrolls that add amulets
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where Coin sound effects would play on the Game Over Leaderboard Popups
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where Prismatic Eye, and Skipping Stone would show incorrect match particles when fighting the Siren enemy
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed various issues with Scroll of the Ram
[/p][/*][/list][p]That’s it for now! Whether you’re diving into a new language version, picking up a controller, or testing out a new build during Steam Next Fest, we can’t wait to hear what you think of the changes.

As always, we’d love to hear your feedback in the forums or Discord. Thanks for playing—and stay Runeborn.

- The Runeborn Team[/p]

notes.title: April Recap - The Road to Early Access
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’re inching closer to Runeborn’s Early Access release this June, and April was all about bringing major systems into final form, tightening player clarity, and deepening community connections.

Here’s everything that happened in April:

[h3]🎨 Runebook Animations Overhaul[/h3]
[list]
[*] The screen you see the most in Runeborn finally got the love it deserved.
[*] Runes now float and shift with a new Idle animation, tied visually to the magic of the intro comic
[*] Hold animations were reworked to feel more responsive and satisfying
[*] A smooth "slam-down" transition was added to bridge states
[*] Polished visual clarity remained our top priority throughout
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/0e156a28c4267fe12915e094f015f23fd1360a1c.gif[/img]
We wanted the Runebook to feel alive without sacrificing the readability and precision you rely on in combat.
[h3]
💡 Spell Line Clarity Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] One common point of confusion was where spell lines begin. We tackled that head-on:
[*] Match previews are now shown directly on held runes
[*] A new pulsing shine moves left to right across match previews to help teach flow
[*] These small additions go a long way in helping new players understand how to play faster
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/5ee8cf6d058d954e4854edf1bac3faa0dad039f5.gif[/img]

[h3]🧠 Community Play Sessions[/h3]
[list]
[*] We launched our first “Play With the Devs” sessions this month.
[*] Full team live gameplay streams hosted directly in our Discord
[*] Real-time Q&A, design commentary, and laughs
[*] All sessions recorded for future sharing and dev diaries
[/list]
Players got to meet the people behind the systems, watch them break stuff, and hear directly about the design process.

Catch up here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_zfdHfJ7BJw
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e4qzjoviUVY
[u][b]More of these events are coming in May![/b][/u]

[h3]⚙️ Systems & Balancing Work[/h3]
[list]
[*] Behind the scenes, April was filled with bug fixes and long-term system planning.
[*] One player shattered our damage cap — that got patched fast
[*] Trinkets are being tuned to scale well into the late game
[*] Balancing efforts now focus on futureproofing for upcoming content
[*] Early work started on our post-EA roadmap
[/list][h3]📣 Help Us Find the Right Creators[/h3]
We’re looking to get Runeborn in front of the right eyes.

If you know a content creator, streamer, or YouTuber who might love Runeborn, send them our way.
Whether they focus on indie games, roguelikes, or deep build systems, we’d love to chat.

[u]Reach out to us in the Discord or tag us on socials. [b]Every connection helps[/b].[/u]

🛒 Wishlist & Review the Demo
If you haven’t yet, wishlist Runeborn on Steam and leave a review on the demo.

These two actions go a long way in helping us stay visible as we prepare for Early Access.
It really does make a difference.


Thank you for being on this Journey with us for Runeborn, and see you in the next one!

[b]👉 Wishlist Runeborn
👉 Review the Demo[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073990/Runeborn/

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Animating your Skills
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Runeborn![/h3]
With the recent feedback and growth the game has experienced in the past few weeks, we decided to overhaul our Runes Idle and Hold state animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/ee57a2e163f88c961b9e97cc67bd957830dd3aee.gif[/img]
[h3]Vs[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/5ee8cf6d058d954e4854edf1bac3faa0dad039f5.gif[/img]

[h2]Why?[/h2]
We've been polishing various parts of the game and realized we had forgotten to take a deeper look at the screen you see the most: [b]the Runes[/b]. When looking at the Runebook and interacting with the board, we felt it lacked juice. So we started coming up with ideas on how we could bring some life to the Runes in their idle state, and at the same time upgrade our Hold animations to fall in line with those new ideas.
[h2]How[/h2]
After brainstorming, we really wanted to tie the idle state of the Runebook into the intro Comic in the game. In the Comic, you see the Runes floating above the book, suspended by some sort of magic; we wanted to try and capture that feeling. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/154669ed267aeede13684b07d0e935e6282bcf0a.png[/img]

Once we added simple idle animations to our Runes, we set out to enhance the Hold animations. At this point, we weren't sure whether the Runes should be floating up above the book in their Idle state, or their Hold state. 

We figured the natural animation between floating and not floating, would be a small bouncy animation of the Rune slamming back down into the Runebook. So, we created the two states: [b]"floating"[/b] and "not floating". At this point, we had a pretty fluid animation between the two states and started working towards polishing them and testing out tons of variations to see what fit best. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/7852a8d7f7d31015cb73af2e2bbdee171f3c220d.gif[/img]

Through testing these variations, I always had something in the back of my mind that I wanted to prioritize above all else: [b]Clarity[/b]. Something we nailed with the original animations was clarity. There was no confusion around what was being held, and what was not. In most of our new iterations, although they looked extra juicy and quite nice ;)... they just weren't hitting the mark in terms of clarity. 

At this point, we'd been through so many iterations. We attempted to remove the original hold seal visuals and color them to their respective rune, to reduce their visibility, etc. In the end, we decided the best thing to do was leave the original hold seal how it was, add some small smokey idle particles to give it a bit of movement, and scale it down with our new animation states. 

What we were left with were two pretty satisfying animation states that hit the mark on clarity and visual juiciness that we wanted to bring the core up to.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/fbf5f1822946408d507364604f9741391d75c6c5.gif[/img]

Once we had finalized the new animations, we wanted to address another problem we were seeing fairly often in our community. Initially, new players had a hard time understanding that a match must connect from the left-most matched rune. 

Something we wanted to do for a while was to better show match previews, which were previously shown upon hovering the Spell Line Bookmark. The first thing that shot out to us was, why don't we show these previews on held runes? So we tested out a version where held matched runes would connect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/222c71f81caff8ff4a8cb68644b7a1320be6203f.gif[/img]

After these nice new match previews were in place, we wanted to add some movement to them to try and solidify that Spell Lines start from left to right. To do this, we added a pulsing shine that moves across the match preview lines. It's subtle, but the devil is in the details. We think it will help hint to new players about how the game works. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/7852a8d7f7d31015cb73af2e2bbdee171f3c220d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/5ee8cf6d058d954e4854edf1bac3faa0dad039f5.gif[/img]

For more thoughts like this and further participate in the conversation:

notes.title: The Future of Runeborn - What's next?
notes.content:
Hello Runeborn! 
This time, we’re bringing you a more serious and reflective Devlog, sharing some important insights and addressing feedback we’ve seen in our community Discord: 

[h3]Steam Next Fest[/h3]
Some may have noticed we opted out of the February Steam Next Fest at the last minute.  We fully intended to participate and had an entire marketing budget with influencers lined up that we couldn’t cancel.  But, we had a serious concern with the demo, and knowing you can only enter Steam Next Fest once, we had to make an important decision.

[h3]What Happened?[/h3]
Last month, we participated in an in-person event hosted by [b][url=https://www.wetech-alliance.com/]WeTech Alliance[/url] and [url=https://www.libro.ca/]Libro Credit Union[/url][/b]. We had the opportunity to share Runeborn with the public, and we learned a very valuable lesson: Make sure you have players playtest your game and [b]watch them play![/b]  When watching first-time users, we noticed they did not understand the need to match from the leftmost column to the right, nor did they understand spell lines 4 &5 (the Vs).  We even told them, but intuitively, they didn’t get it.  

We often saw players create a two or three-match on the right side of the screen and then get disappointed when it wasn’t counted.  That disappointment is your worst nightmare as a game developer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/c5b3bf8748760bbc01a54b9dc772753eecb90d10.png[/img]


This realization shook us to the core, so much so that we opted out of Steam Next Fest and paused all development to investigate a solution.  We didn’t want to present our game to the world if many gamers didn’t ‘get it’ naturally.  [i]And yes, we have a tutorial explaining it, but it didn’t seem enough.[/i]

We spent a week developing a new prototype that we thought would solve the problem.  It didn’t.  It only created more questions and other problems to solve.  So, instead, we went back to the drawing board to figure out how to fix our current solution.

[h3]Our Fix[/h3]
We’ve added animations and VFX details to emphasize when a match is legit. When a scoring match is made, a connector line is created, binding the two runes together. We’ve also added an animation on the connector line showing movement from left to right. We hope this reinforces the need to create matches from the leftmost column to the right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/222c71f81caff8ff4a8cb68644b7a1320be6203f.gif[/img]

[h3]Other Improvements[/h3]
We were fortunate to have YouTube influencer [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vd4g63j3McI]Olexa[/url] stream our game, significantly boosting new players. That brought an influx of feedback and recommendations through our Discord channel, which we’ve worked hard to implement.

[list][*] [b]Visual updates[/b][list]

[*] Floating runes
[*] Spell lines connectors
[*] Boss mechanic update
[*] Sped up the intro comic
[*] Elite and boss intro screens[/list][*] [b]Steam cloud save[/b]
[*] [b]Lots of small bug fixes[/b][/list]
[h3]Conclusion[/h3]
Although we’re disappointed that we opted out of Steam Next Fest at the last minute, our influencer marketing efforts paid off. We learned a lot about how people play our game through an in-person event. We attempted a pivot and decided it wasn’t the right decision.

Ultimately, creating clearer feedback for our users was the right thing. We really hope you enjoy the updates. Stay tuned for our [b]next Runeborn Demo build[/b], which will go live on [b]March 25th, 2025[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/eb646e3d8b90bb9f49ed719baa0c329a8fc02683.png[/img]

Lastly, we have opted into the June Steam Next Fest and will use the next three months to polish our Early Access build.  Stay tuned for its [b]release date shortly after Steam Next Fest.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/f1a1ebd4f2f794fac8b15bee44659d87cab8e0b1.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo Ver. 0.2.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/1495767d94f7243e51c1518603fa8a79042c724d.png[/img]

Greetings Runeborn!
We’ve been hard at work enhancing your Runeborn experience, and today, we’re thrilled to share the latest updates in the demo build. Dive into the detailed patch notes below and see what’s new!

[olist]
[*][h3]New Features and Enhancements[/h3][list]
[*] Tutorial: Added a full guided tutorial for newcomers.
[*] More Save States: Taking actions in shops and opening chests now save progress.[/list]
[*][h3] Visual and UI Improvements:[/h3][list]
[*] Added idle wobble animations for level-select cards, chest options, and trinkets.
[*] Adjusted trinket and consumable UI size.
[*] Updated options HUD layout from vertical to horizontal.
[*] There is a new loading screen with quotes.
[*] Default font color updated for better readability.[/list]
[*] [h3]Feedback Systems:[/h3][list]
[*] Added feedback for various actions, including Dawnbringer, Stamp of Approval, and Cambrian Explosion.
[*] Resource globes added for casts and meditations.[/list]
[*][h3]Leaderboards:[/h3][list]
[*] Personal leaderboard for top 10 highest casts from unique runs.
[*] Leaderboards shown on the game win and game over screens.[/list]
[*] [h3]Miscellaneous Updates:[/h3][list]
[*] Added a Discord button to the main menu.
[*] Dynamic tooltip highlighting.
[*] New coin assets and a liquid shader.
[*] Options to adjust or disable Near Death Effects.[/list]
[*] [h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Resolved tooltip issues with spell line bookmarks and rune smasher.
[*] Fixed incorrect item sold states in shops.
[*] Corrected elite target selection for specific interactions.
[*] Fixed synchronization issues with Vypras held runes.
[*] Issues with the Forbidden Scroll of Replication were addressed, deleting multiple amethyst trinkets.
[*] Fixed misaligned text on gem shop socket buttons on sale.
[*] Resolved infinite loops with Copycat trinkets.
[*] Fixed animation bugs on the main menu and level start effects.
[*] Arachnis resets max holds correctly after changing disabled trinket targets.[/list][/olist]


We hope you enjoy these updates! Let us know your thoughts on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3158420/discussions/][b]Steam discussions[/b][/url] or join the conversation on [url=https://discord.gg/qcYywfmZ][b]Discord[/b][/url]. 

Your feedback shapes the future of Runeborn!

notes.title: Update 0.1.66
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/0b95bff84bb9b91affd7e8467d2fad9d7057731e.png[/img]

This is the last weekend for the playtest!
We’d love your final feedback before we shut it down on Monday, Oct 22nd, at 4pm EST.

[h2]Summary[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed Cast animation flow to no longer wait for a Spell Lines animations to completely finish before moving onto the next Spell Lines animations
[*] Added toasts when new Help Entries are unlocked
[*] Added sub-text to the Rune Bundle popup and Forbidden Scroll Bundle popup
[*] Added a tooltip to the Rune Inventory button
[*] Added Dusk feedback when Earth runes are destroyed with Distortion Lens
[*] Added more Tutorial improvements
[*] Added Notification Pips to the Collections Screen and menu buttons
[*] Added Notification Pips to the Help menu button on the main menu and Help button in game
[*] Added an error message popup if you try to use a Scroll of Destruction on runes that would make the column inventory go below the minimum number of runes
[*] Updated copied Empty Boxes to also copy it's empty slot effect
[*] Updated Scroll / Forbidden Scroll art
[*] Updated button disabled states to make them differ more from enabled buttons
[*] Updated Donation Box effect to: +1 Coin for every Match that contains a Light Rune
[*] Updated New Game Screen to show off features coming in Early Access
[*] Updated Hide Shop/Chest button to say Spellbook
[*] Updated naming of Chests to Bundles
[*] Updated Tutorial to not force you into the game on first load
[*] Updated Sell flow to use drag and drop rather than a button click
[*] Updated visuals on Level Select for Elite, Act Boss, and Final Boss cards
[*] Updated Drag bounds for Trinkets/Consumables to better improve accidentally swapping Trinkets when moving Trinkets to the Gem Shop
[*] Updated Faberge Egg tooltip description when it can be used
[*] Updated the Leaderboard visuals
[*] Added Spell Line previews when hovering a Spell Line Bookmark
[*] Held Runes now get re-Held after using a Scroll
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the error message for Greed was incorrect when your inventory was at the minimum Rune count
[*] Fixed an issue where Skipping Stone would cause the Spell Line tooltip previews to error
[*] Fixed an issue where having multiple Seed Pack's wouldn't show the correct +Match value in the Spell Line tooltips
[*] Fixed an issue where Runes in the Rune Smasher shop could have their amulets visually disappear when destroying a Rune
[*] Fixed an issue where continuing a game that was left on the Level Complete screen showed the coin value you would be at after collecting it
[*] Fixed an issue where Holster scrolls granted holds would be removed if used in a shop
[*] Fixed an issue where Necromantic Amulets would destroy runes without taking into account the Rune Inventory minimum
[*] Fixed an issue where fighting Slythera a second time would cause the visuals to not animate for the meditate button
[*] Fixed an issue where Bosses that added amulets would play the Add Amulet animation for all Runes with amulets
[*] Fixed an issue where Gem animations could cause an error upon exiting the game to the main menu
[*] Fixed an issue where Boss cards in Level Select would have a tooltip shown by default
[*] Fixed an issue where number displays for trinkets and runes could have the most recent text below previously triggered text, making it not legible
[*] Fixed an issue where Brontis could target and destroy runes in a column that was at the minimum number of runes
[*] Fixed an issue where tooltips on the Game End screen were erroring
[*] Fixed an issue where other language locales would cause a soft lock
[*] Fixed an issue where the Scroll of Destruction would cause on error when used on an empty Rune
[*] Fixed an issue where the Damage Breakdown Popup would show Spell Lines 4 and 5 when fighting Spider
[*] Fixed an issue where Chameleon Tail would not duplicate Helping Hand properly
[*] Fixed an issue where coins could desync after gaining lots of coins from a cast
[*] Fixed an issue where game controls could be on the screen at the wrong time
[*] Fixed an issue where aura's caused damage numbers to stick on the screen during a cast
[*] Fixed an issue where Scroll of the Ram could move Vypras frozen Rune
[*] Fixed an issue with hovering Spell Line Bookmarks would play the match highlight animation when casting
[*] Fixed an issue in The Gemweaver where you could place the same Trinket in both transfer gem slots
[/list]
